deployment_notes: Manifest regenerated 2026-06-28 from the live mcp-marketplace + BATCH_BUILD_REPORT_2026-06-27.json (batch build v3).
479 MCPs build clean (93.6%), 33 TypeScript MCPs need no build, 0 real build-fails.
Owner-gated: set PYPI_TOKEN + 'bash scripts/publish-all-bridges.sh' ships all 479 Python packages.
Owner-gated: 'mcp-publisher login github' + 'SUBMIT=1 bash scripts/submit-all-registry.sh' ships all 479 to MCP registry.

bulk_commands.clone_all: for repo in $(python3 -c 'import json; print("\n".join(e["name"] for e in json.load(open("MCP_DEPLOYMENT_MANIFEST.json"))["deployable_servers"]))'); do gh repo clone "CSOAI-ORG/$repo" "mcp-marketplace/$repo"; done
bulk_commands.install_all: for d in mcp-marketplace/*/; do (cd "$d" && pip install -e .) 2>/dev/null; done
bulk_commands.validate_all_syntax: for d in mcp-marketplace/*/; do (cd "$d" && python3 -m py_compile server.py 2>/dev/null && echo "✓ $d") || echo "✗ $d"; done

publish_all.py_command: export PYPI_TOKEN=*** && for d in mcp-marketplace/*/-mcp/; do (cd "$d" && twine upload dist/* --skip-existing) 2>/dev/null; done
publish_all.registry_command: SUBMIT=1 for d in mcp-marketplace/*/-mcp/; do (cd "$d" && mcp-publisher publish) 2>/dev/null; done

publish_sequence: 2. Owner runs: bash scripts/publish-all-bridges.sh (ships 479 packages to PyPI in ~10 min)
4. Owner runs: SUBMIT=1 bash scripts/submit-all-registry.sh (ships 479 server.json to MCP registry)
5. Auto: The 23 flagship repos auto-crawl Smithery/Glama within ~24h
6. M2 MacBook: AirDrop bundle from ~/Desktop/, git pull, update 6 surfaces in csoai-v2-app
7. Traffic flows: 479 packages on PyPI + 479 server.json on registry = SEO + answer-engine discovery begins
